brief: 6 mindset shifts that changed everything for me at 30.

slots.title: MINDSET SHIFTS THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING AT 30
DONE BEATS PERFECT
slots.body: I spent years polishing work that never shipped. Shipping something imperfect taught me that momentum matters more than polish. Progress lives in the publish button.

slots.title: NO IS A SENTENCE
slots.body: I said yes to everyone and lost myself in the process. Boundaries are not walls; they are filters for what deserves your energy. Protect your time like an asset.

slots.title: FAILURE IS JUST FEEDBACK
slots.body: Every setback at thirty felt like a verdict. Reframing failure as feedback turned my worst moments into my most valuable curriculum. The data never lies.

slots.title: INVEST IN RELATIONSHIPS EARLY
slots.body: I used to think success was a solo sport. The truth is that doors open because of people, not just talent. Build your circle before you need it.

slots.title: STOP TRADING TIME FOR MONEY
slots.body: Chasing paychecks kept me comfortable and stuck. When I started viewing money as a tool for freedom, my decisions got bolder. Wealth is bought with strategy, not hours.

slots.title: CLARITY COMES FROM ACTION
slots.body: I waited for the perfect plan before moving. Clarity does not arrive in a spreadsheet; it arrives mid-motion. You learn the path by walking it.

slots.headline: START YOUR FIRST SHIFT TODAY
slots.body: Pick one mindset and test it this week. Your next chapter starts with a single decision.
